p_test_interpretation: Compare beta/SE normal Wald to BOTH SPA p.value and normal p.value.NA; differences from SPA are not automatically invalid. No allele flips or SE repairs based on P concordance. Resolve source algorithm before likelihood readiness.
summary_row_gate: valid signed source semantics, finite beta, positive finite SE, valid p, coherent source allelic ID, converged SPA, MAC>=10, Rsq>=0.7, positive N, valid AF
ld_gate: No LD source is assumed. All locus LD and sample/summary compatibility gates remain failed/not-run until legitimate compatible signed dense source acquired and audited.
reference_validation: Provider REF/ALT and hg19 are recorded; exact sequence match and normalization required before complete identity gate. No reference-source inference from AF or effect sign.
palindromes: Source REF/ALT contrast is preserved; no strand change without independent coordinate/reference evidence.
duplicates: Retain all source rows and report identity/coordinate groups. Identical copies deterministically first source row only for future proposal; conflicts excluded explicitly, never silently merged.
